subject.title: [Control UI] 部分模块中文翻译缺失

question: Should this issue remain the broad Control UI zh-CN tab-localization tracker while maintainers sequence focused tab PRs, or should it be narrowed or superseded?
rationale: Current main still has source-reproducible English UI copy, but the remaining work spans overlapping/conflicting PRs plus translation-scope choices that automation should not resolve unilaterally.

options.title: Keep broad UI tracker
options.body: Use this issue to coordinate tab-by-tab Control UI zh-CN fixes while requiring focused PRs to follow the generated i18n pipeline.

options.title: Narrow to original tabs
options.body: Limit this issue to Agents, Skills, Channels, Sessions, Nodes, and Debug, and route Settings, chat metadata, docs, CLI, and runtime localization to linked items.

options.title: Supersede into localization program
options.body: Move the remaining work to a larger localization-coverage tracker only after choosing a viable canonical item and preserving these tab-specific findings.

recommendation.title: Keep broad UI tracker
recommendation.body: Use this issue to coordinate tab-by-tab Control UI zh-CN fixes while requiring focused PRs to follow the generated i18n pipeline.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main blame for sampled affected Control UI files points to this recent area contributor, and the decision is about coordinating overlapping UI localization work.
